        self.text(340, "[Q] Quit", GRAY)

        self.last_diff = key
        self.name, self.interval = DIFFS[key]
        self.snake = [(COLS // 2, ROWS // 2)]

        self.state = "over"

        self.text(mid + 30, "[R] Restart   [M] Main Menu   [Q] Quit", WHITE)
        self.status.config(text="Score: %d   Difficulty: %s" % (self.score, self.name))

    def spawn_food(self):
        while True:
            p = (random.randrange(COLS), random.randrange(ROWS))
            if p not in self.snake:

            elif k in ("q", "Q"):

            self.food = self.spawn_food()
        else:

        self.draw_board()
        self.job = self.root.after(self.interval, self.tick)

        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(self.snake):

    SnakeGame(root)
    root.mainloop()

UP = (0, -1)
DOWN = (0, 1)
LEFT = (-1, 0)
RIGHT = (1, 0)
OPPOSITE = {UP: DOWN, DOWN: UP, LEFT: RIGHT, RIGHT: LEFT}


class Snake:
    def __init__(self, length=4):
        cx, cy = GRID_W // 2, GRID_H // 2
        self.cells = [(cx - i, cy) for i in range(length)]
        self.direction = RIGHT
        self.next_direction = RIGHT
        self.grow_pending = 0

    def turn(self, direction):
        if direction != OPPOSITE[self.direction]:
            self.next_direction = direction

    def step(self):
        self.direction = self.next_direction
        hx, hy = self.cells[0]
        head = (hx + self.direction[0], hy + self.direction[1])
        self.cells.insert(0, head)
        if self.grow_pending:
            self.grow_pending -= 1
        else:
            self.cells.pop()
        return head

    def eat(self):
        self.grow_pending += 1

    def hits_wall(self):
        x, y = self.cells[0]
        return not (0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H)

    def hits_self(self):
        return self.cells[0] in self.cells[1:]
